gap_sweep_note: Sensitivity analysis, not a search. The QueryStream paper leaves the Appendix A.4 event-grouping gap unspecified; this run was recorded at the gap in `config.event_gap_s` and that row is the headline. Larger gaps are scored EXACTLY -- they select a strict subset of the responses already generated, whose text is in the JSONL -- so no GPU is involved and content is fully included. Quoting the best row as the result would be tuning against the benchmark.
